title: Lights Race
summary: A lights out race on own boards: everyone gets the same board and plays it at once, and each friend's board is drawn live beside yours with their name, avatar and score.

verified.result: PASS gates 6/6, measures 22/22; measure 5's presence leg: boards on both screens, 2 of 2 presses each way showed on the other screen's copy of that board within 3 s, each pointer seen on its board
verified.how: node bin/gamesfun.mjs create <dir> --from lights-race, then node builder/tools/verify.mjs <dir> (a build verify, every build measure; 185 s) under gpu-run.sh on Linux with a desktop GPU (CHROME_ARGS="--use-gl=angle --use-angle=gl-egl")
